Which kinds of game studios does Designali work with?
Mostly indie and small studios, from solo developers to teams of a few dozen, across PC, console and mobile games.
Can you design in-game UI as well as the website?
Yes. Ali Imam designs both, so the store page, the launch site and the HUD share one visual language.
What do I receive at the end?
Figma source files, exported assets, a Next.js codebase where included, and documentation for your team.
Do you work with existing brands?
Absolutely. We can refresh a current identity or extend it into new key art, UI or a launch site.
What does the website stack look like?
Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel, so the site is fast and easy for your team to update.
